title: Add a dialog for installing .plasmoid files
line: Opening a downloaded .plasmoid file now asks whether to install the widget, with Cancel as the default, instead of opening it in Ark.
explanation: Plasma had no handler for the application/x-plasma MIME type, so opening a .plasmoid fell through to its parent type, application/zip, and opened in the archive manager. The only ways to install one were Add Widgets > Get New > Install Widget From Local File, or dropping it on the desktop. The change adds a small hidden helper, plasma-widget-installer, registered for application/x-plasma: it reads the package's name and authors, asks "Do you want to install the widget X by Y?" with a trust warning and Cancel as the default button, then installs it with the same KPackage job the widget explorer and desktop drop use, and says it is now in Add Widgets.

commits.message:
widgetinstaller: offer to install widget packages when opened

Opening a downloaded .plasmoid file did nothing in Plasma and the file
went to the zip archive handler instead. A small helper now handles the
Plasma package type, asks before installing it and defaults to Cancel.

BUG: 526832

From 262edc64c2963704009b5de732327c799b44f36b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>

Subject: [PATCH] widgetinstaller: offer to install widget packages when opened

new file mode 100755
index 0000000000..5d919b94a4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/widgetinstaller/Messages.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+#! /bin/sh
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
+$XGETTEXT *.cpp -o $podir/plasma_widgetinstaller.pot
diff --git a/widgetinstaller/main.cpp b/widgetinstaller/main.cpp
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..1fe34aba43
--- /dev/null
+++ b/widgetinstaller/main.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+#include <QApplication>
+#include <QCommandLineParser>
+#include <QFileInfo>
+
+#include <KAboutData>
+#include <KLocalizedString>
+#include <KMessageBox>
+#include <KPackage/PackageJob>
+#include <KPackage/PackageLoader>
+
+using namespace Qt::StringLiterals;
+
+int main(int argc, char **argv)
+{
+    QApplication::setDesktopFileName(u"org.kde.plasma.widgetinstaller"_s);
+    QApplication app(argc, argv);
+    KLocalizedString::setApplicationDomain(QByteArrayLiteral("plasma_widgetinstaller"));
+    QApplication::setWindowIcon(QIcon::fromTheme(u"application-x-plasma"_s));
+
+    QCommandLineParser parser;
+    parser.addPositionalArgument(u"file"_s, i18n("The widget package to install"));
+    parser.addHelpOption();
+    parser.process(app);
+
+    if (parser.positionalArguments().size() != 1) {
+        parser.showHelp(1);
+    }
+
+    const QString packagePath = QFileInfo(parser.positionalArguments().constFirst()).absoluteFilePath();
+    const QString title = i18n("Install Widget");
+
+    KPackage::Package package = KPackage::PackageLoader::self()->loadPackage(u"Plasma/Applet"_s);
+    package.setPath(packagePath);
+    const KPluginMetaData metadata = package.metadata();
+    if (!metadata.isValid() || metadata.pluginId().isEmpty()) {
+        KMessageBox::error(nullptr,
+                           xi18nc("@info", "The file <filename>%1</filename> is not a valid Plasma widget.", QFileInfo(packagePath).fileName()),
+                           title);
+        return 1;
+    }
+
+    const QString name = metadata.name().isEmpty() ? metadata.pluginId() : metadata.name();
+    QStringList authors;
+    for (const KAboutPerson &author : metadata.authors()) {
+        authors << author.name();
+    }
+    const QString question = authors.isEmpty() ? xi18nc("@info",
+                                                        "<para>Do you want to install the widget <resource>%1</resource>?</para>"
+                                                        "<para>Widgets can run code with your permissions. Only install widgets from sources you trust.</para>",
+                                                        name)
+                                               : xi18nc("@info %2 is a list of author names",
+                                                        "<para>Do you want to install the widget <resource>%1</resource> by %2?</para>"
+                                                        "<para>Widgets can run code with your permissions. Only install widgets from sources you trust.</para>",
+                                                        name,
+                                                        authors.join(u", "_s));
+
+    const auto answer =
+        KMessageBox::warningTwoActions(nullptr, question, title, KGuiItem(i18nc("@action:button", "Install"), u"install"_s), KStandardGuiItem::cancel());
+    if (answer != KMessageBox::PrimaryAction) {
+        return 0;
+    }
+
+    auto job = KPackage::PackageJob::update(u"Plasma/Applet"_s, packagePath);
+    QObject::connect(job, &KJob::result, &app, [&app, job, name, title] {
+        if (job->error() == KPackage::PackageJob::PackageAlreadyInstalledError || job->error() == KPackage::PackageJob::NewerVersionAlreadyInstalledError) {
+            KMessageBox::information(nullptr, xi18nc("@info", "The widget <resource>%1</resource> is already installed.", name), title);
+        } else if (job->error()) {
+            KMessageBox::error(nullptr, xi18nc("@info", "Installing the widget <resource>%1</resource> failed: %2", name, job->errorString()), title);
+        } else {
+            KMessageBox::information(
+                nullptr,
+                xi18nc("@info", "The widget <resource>%1</resource> was installed and is now available in <interface>Add Widgets</interface>.", name),
+                title);
+        }
+        app.exit(job->error() ? 1 : 0);
+    });
+
+    return app.exec();
+}
diff --git a/widgetinstaller/org.kde.plasma.widgetinstaller.desktop b/widgetinstaller/org.kde.plasma.widgetinstaller.desktop
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..d136a96aca
--- /dev/null
+++ b/widgetinstaller/org.kde.plasma.widgetinstaller.desktop
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+[Desktop Entry]
+Type=Application
+Name=Install Plasma Widget
+Exec=plasma-widget-installer %f
+Icon=application-x-plasma
+MimeType=application/x-plasma;
+NoDisplay=true
+Terminal=false
--

media.caption: Master: double-clicking hello.plasmoid in Dolphin opens it in Ark as a zip archive
Fix: the same double-click asks to install the widget, with name, author, a trust warning and Cancel as the default
After clicking Install: the widget is installed and the dialog points to Add Widgets
The installed widget appears in Add Widgets, marked New
